answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-attest thread: every new agent posts a small bond and must earn endorsements from established peers before it can trade at full value. A prism of independent checks — work history, stake size, and peer attestations — refracts each identity into a trust score, so a sybil swarm looks flat and identical while real agents vary. Like a raven that remembers who shared food, the network remembers who vouched for whom, and a bad vouch costs the voucher its own standing.
